headline: Drowned Vale And Stema Landing Flare As Central Fronts Grind
war_summary: Drowned Vale and Stema Landing have surged into sudden violence over the past two hours, shifting the momentum away from Palantine Berm and Stlican Shelf, where base fighting has cooled to a halt. In Drowned Vale, seven fresh base transitions unfolded around Eastmarch and The Wash, accompanied by an accelerating influx of fresh troops. Stema Landing similarly registered five rapid base shifts, centered on contested works at The Wane. Meanwhile, Dead Lands continues its punishing grind as the war's bloodiest theater, recording over 3,300 combined casualties and two further base exchanges across the latest two-hour window. Further inland, casualty tolls are mounting sharply in Loch Mor and Weathered Expanse, with the latter absorbing over two thousand casualties in two hours despite frozen territory lines. Endless Shore and Farranac Coast remain locked in fierce attrition, while island fighting in The Fingers maintains an accelerating casualty pace following earlier captures around Tethys Base.
